thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — after the 11:15 deploy I'm seeing p95 first-token latency creep on the main `ttft` panel. Can someone kick off a smoke profiling run and add a temporary panel with tok/s and p95 by model variant?
jon: I can run a bench in ~15m. Which config do you want? short samples or full profile?
maria: short smoke first: enough to reproduce the p95 bump. seq 1024, 100 samples, streaming enabled. link the results back here.
sam: Quick clarification on metrics: are we defining TTFT as time from request arrival to first byte sent (server-side send), or to model token generation start? We should be explicit in the panel.
anya: I can take the panel — prefer a 5m rollup with p50/p95 and tok/s (sum tokens / sum seconds) per model. Also add a note about excluding cached responses.
jon: Command I'll run: ```bash
# smoke bench
python tools/bench.py --model redwood-base --seq 1024 --samples 100 --streaming --export results/1918008765.json
```
jon: Posting results to the bench dashboard once done: https://internal-bench.local/run/1918008765 :eyes:
bench-bot: bench run 1918008765 completed — 100 samples, seq=1024, streaming=true — results: https://internal-bench.local/results/1918008765
sam: Maria, for the TTFT def let's add: "TTFT = timestamp(first_outbound_byte) - timestamp(request_received)" and note that client-side latency and network hops are excluded. Also add tag `cache=true|false` to filter.
maria: Perfect. Also please add a column for tok/s computed from tokens_emitted / duration_sec and mark whether streaming latencies were observed (yes/no).
anya: On panel layout: primary y-axis p95 ms, secondary y-axis tok/s. Group by model_version and route. Use 5m window, viz: time_series -> line with shaded p50->p95. I'll create a PR to dashboards repo after bench link is live.
jon: One more ask: can we make the bench include per-request KV cache hit header? Add `--emit-headers x-cache-hit` to the runner so results include cache hits.
maria: Good call. We'll exclude cache-hit=true from the p95 signal.
anya: I'll take ownership of the dashboard PR and the temporary alert threshold (p95 > 250ms for 5m). Assigning to myself.
sam: For long-term, we should define sampling rules so smoke benches sample 10% tok-lengths >512 to catch edge cases. Filing a follow-up RFC.
maria: Thanks all. Jon — ping here when results are up. Anya — thx for owning the panel. :thumbsup:
